examRefs.en: This form of exercise emphasizes low-intensity and long-duration running, aiming to improve endurance and reduce the risk of injury by slowing down the running pace.
examRefs.zh: 這種運動形式強調低強度、長時間的跑步，旨在透過放慢跑步步調來提升耐力並減少受傷風險。

examRefs.en: Maintain an upright posture and jog at a pace slightly faster than walking to ensure that you can hold a conversation comfortably.
examRefs.zh: 保持挺拔的姿勢，以稍微快於走路的速度慢跑，以確保你能舒適地交談。

examRefs.en: Still, with better editing and a tighter pace, it could have been a truly outstanding one.
examRefs.zh: 不過，如果能有更好的剪輯和更緊湊的節奏，它本可以成為一部真正出色的作品。
